fullContentHtml:
IIT GATE Online Form 2027 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Institute of Technology IIT Madras has recently released the notification for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027 on its official website. The online application process for IIT GATE Online Form 2026 has started on 27 August 2026, and candidates can apply till 27 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for IIT GATE Online Form 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 August 2026
  • Last Date : 27 September 2026
  • Last Date For Fee Payment : 27 September 2026
  • Last Date For Apply With Late Fee : 05 October 2026
  • Application rectification : 14 to 21 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 06, 07, 13, 14, 20 & 21 February 2027
  • Exam City Details : 04 January 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Answer Key : Notified Soon
  • Result : 19 March 2026

Application Fee

  • Phase I
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1000/-
  • All category Female : Rs. 1000/-
  • For Phase II (With Late Fee)
  • General, OBC : Rs. 2,500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1,500/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 1500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through ITI College Prepaid Coupon, Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking Mode Only.
